reviews.text: The service was great. Debby was able to give Fatboy his medication and even fed, water the outdoor colony the days of her service.   A tremendous amount of detail in her notes & remained in contact with updates.

I have felt so relieved since finding Debby and Professional Cat Sitting Plus! I can come home even after a week away and find my cats happy, healthy, and calm. Debby is an excellent, proactive communicator. I love getting the pictures and updates while we're away, and rest easy knowing our cats are in loving hands.

Debby is kind, professional, experienced, and very, very good with my cat, Tiddlywink, who needs several medications (including chemotherapy) every day, as well as infinite cuddles and love at all times. This past week, while Debby was sitting for Tiddlywink, I got sick and had to delay my return by two days. During that time, Debby was flexible and compassionate enough to keep taking care of Tiddlywink. She provided a care sheet, a log of visits, and regular updates with photos and videos by phone. Thank you, Debby, for keeping Tiddlywink happy and healthy!

Debby is an amazing cat sitter!  She watched cat TV with my cat until Loviefluffy warmed up. Now Loviefluffy lets Debby hold her and give her kisses! She won’t even let me do that! Debby is absolutely reliable and knows what to do in any situation.  She’s the very best!!!

I am so glad that I found Debby to be my cat sitter. I can relax when I am away knowing that Debby treats my cat like she would treat her own. My cat does not have as much anxiety when I travel because Debby is so loving with him. I also don't have to worry about my little cat colony being neglected while I am gone because Debby makes sure that they are fed and given water. She also provides great tips which help me keep my outdoor cats healthy also. I HIGHLY recommend Debby, she really is the best.
Ms. Debby is amazing at what she does. She takes her time with my elderly baby cat and makes her feel comfortable for weekly subq fluids.
